scientific_integrity: All statements and quantitative certificates derive from finite combinatorial definitions, explicit witnesses, and separately recomputed complete enumerations. No claims of external certification, independence, or priority are made.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite result for closed neighborhoods of J(6,3) and first-order comparison among all smaller Johnson graphs, not a general Johnson-rank classification. The four-query trace spectrum is established by exhaustive orbit coverage and independent direct enumeration. Comprehensive historical priority and independent audit remain outstanding.
title: The first closed-Johnson online-shattering gap and its four-query trace spectrum
